answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a sonnet bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every haven settlement recomputes the voyage schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
